limitations: The report covers all 13,676 entries in the XboxRecomp split manifest; a separate refined detector inventory contains 16,598 candidates.
Candidate ranges are heuristic and include overlaps; they are not a proven complete original linked-unit inventory.
All objdiff report units are explicitly incomplete. Exact byte matches at candidate boundaries do not prove whole-game completion or runtime behavior.

The current comparison uses 401 locally compiled MSVC x86 objects from current manual C reconstructions; 15 sources failed compilation and have no base object in this report. Source C, objects, and detailed evidence remain private.

The comparison uses objdiff 3.8.2 against XboxRecomp split candidate objects. Exact means the compiled base candidate code bytes match the target candidate bytes; fuzzy-only and unmatched candidates are not exact reconstructions.
